required_checks: Validate schema selected by record_type; unknown fields rejected
Derive signer id from actual key using existing BTX ResearchIdentityId
Verify signature over full canonical body and network/domain
Verify issuer/delegation authorization before update or tombstone
Strict timeline ordering and minimum margins
Fixed roster and principal-derived eligibility at funding transaction
Own refund key and exact complete P2MR script tree
SIGHASH_ALL exact transaction and authorized beneficiary/fees
Sealed fields required iff sealed; never public secret in metadata
No remote authority flags treated as local verified/confirmed
Evaluation environment/task coverage and aggregation rules
Idempotency, authorization reservations and revocation before side effects
